node.title: XR classification: members of the exchange-inverse class C_XR are paid
node.notes: the content beyond even moments — the genuinely new ingredient every mechanism needs
node.statement: Every member of the class C_XR produced by the exchange inverse theorem (xr_inverse) is tangent-type, quotient-type, or extension-type — or is a NEW named ledger. The class is complete BY CONSTRUCTION of the inverse step; this node is pure classification.
